posts.name: Jeysie
posts.cooked:
While I'm a bit disappointed at apparently not getting Biomancer's episode any time soon, I remember Christopher saying he wanted to do something really special for the 40th episode, so I'm not at all surprised they went for Guise's episode. Plus it makes Powerhound happy!

Although the Fanatic and Apostate and Wager Master episodes are probably going to be outright crazy in their own right. Whoo boy. Actually, this is pretty much the entire month of "let's explain all the really really crazy weird characters that are going to have weird existential cosmic relevance".

Speaking of Biomancer, though, it was interesting to find out a bit more about what really happened with Con, and I feel like I can now go back to picturing Chrono and Con as Sam and Al again. Though now I'm even more interested in just what the heck Biomancer's ultimate motivations are for all these shenangians.

Finding out my precious psychic child apparently got to hold an entire important hero party makes me not mind waiting until the OblivAeon ep. :D Also it seems the Tactics timeline continues to suck a whole bunch, hands up everyone who's surprised...

posts.name: MindWanderer
posts.cooked:
When Biomancer didn't immediately follow the Scholar, I felt for sure they were saving him for the Halloween episode.  But no, we get Wager Master--who, to be fair, is probably the most terrifying villain of all.

CON is turning out to be much more interesting that we suspected.  Now we know that Biomancer is responsible for his turning "evil" temporarily.  We know that CON deliberately aligned the time badge to absorb the energy of Chrono's successful bounties, effectively forcing him to obey as instructed or be stuck.  And we also know that CON's ability to move Chrono within his own timestream is a result of OblivAeon somehow.  I hope we get all of this explained at some point.
